title: PipeshubApprovalsDocument
description: The configuration document /services/agentHarness/approvals (P2.6c). The Python worker reads its rule layers (default, then agents[agentKey]; each only narrows), written by the operator. An edition's overlay may add top-level sections (x-extensible), each a map of orgId to that org's entry, read through the edition's own rules. An unknown top-level key or a section that is not an object makes the document invalid: the worker fails closed (writes ask). An entry the rules schema refuses fails closed for that entry only.

default.description: Every org of the deployment (operator only).
